mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ch.id) AS totalChapters, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lr.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN ch.id END) AS completedChapters, ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ch.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lr.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN ch.id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ch.id) END, 1 ) AS overallProgressPercent FROM chapter ch LEFT JOIN courseware cw ON ch.id = cw.chapter_id LEFT JOIN learning_record lr ON cw.id = lr.courseware_id AND lr.student_id = #{studentId} WHERE ch.course_id = #{courseId}
